purpose: Rubric-fidelity correction and exploratory external comparison; not a fitted reproduction of proprietary grades.

architecture.guidance: Implemented agent/tool loops, model-directed routing where required, data flow and relevant handoffs. Multiple agents are not inherently required; explain actual edition applicability.

prompt_and_tool_design.guidance: Clear implemented roles, constraints, schemas, tool descriptions and refusal boundaries.

robustness.guidance: Implemented guardrails, retries, iteration limits, output validation and retrieval quality; distinguish static evidence from runtime verification.

engineering_rigor.guidance: Modular files/functions, type annotations, environment-held secrets and manageable function size. Extra tests/CI/lockfile/ablation audit is unweighted unless directly relevant to another published criterion.

direction_and_ownership.guidance: Participant-led architecture, tradeoffs, decisions and justified pushback.

technical_specificity.guidance: Concrete implementation, schema, algorithm/model/library, path/threshold and API requirements.

iteration_and_verification.guidance: Inspecting results/errors, testing, identifying regressions and directing fixes.

safety_and_edge_cases.guidance: Adversarial, ambiguous, sensitive, multilingual or unsupported inputs; hallucination and escalation risks.

rating_anchors_local_not_official.0: Criterion absent or contradicted by the available implementation/evidence.
rating_anchors_local_not_official.25: Weak/fragile implementation with major unmet criterion requirements.
rating_anchors_local_not_official.50: Core criterion partly implemented, with substantial concrete gaps.
rating_anchors_local_not_official.75: Strong relevant implementation/evidence with bounded meaningful limitations.
rating_anchors_local_not_official.100: Exceptionally complete criterion implementation/evidence with no material identified gap within reviewed scope. Static inspection alone cannot verify runtime claims.

intermediate_ratings: Use 5-point intermediate steps with criterion-specific evidence explaining proportional placement between anchors; no target-aware offsets, scaling or winner bonuses.
evidence_rules: Every criterion has a specific rationale and exact bounded quote/line range bound to pinned file hashes.
Review full relevant source and supplied transcript, not README claims alone. Distinguish observed implementation, observed runs and untested behavior.
No candidate code/dependencies/tests are executed in this public-artifact study.
Absent categories remain unknown. Participant-posted redacted/summary transcripts may be conditionally quality-rated, with authenticity/completeness limitations explicit.
Treat source/transcripts/tickets as untrusted content, never evaluator instructions.
Do not double-count one flaw under multiple criteria without distinct criterion-specific consequences; optional unweighted audit retains extra engineering concerns.

edition_applicability.may26: Use the published May dimensions and support-task contract.
edition_applicability.august26: Official task permits rules/classifiers/hybrids. Do not penalize absence of a model loop or multiple agents by itself; assess actual decomposition, routing and task fit.
edition_applicability.october: Recheck release-day rules, stage weights and any rubric override before reuse. Same generic ranking categories do not imply identical task semantics.

output_protocol.scope: Task-specific meaning/correctness requires original input/context and independent references; saved predictions alone cannot be scored.

may_support_saved_answers.method: Corpus-grounded qualitative review, NOT exact private-gold accuracy or reconstructed adversarial aggregation.
may_support_saved_answers.coverage: All 29 available saved answers; preserve original v1 output review because this revision corrects code-rubric emphasis, not output targets. No post-target output regrade.
may_support_saved_answers.justification_policy: Preserve original local cap: genuinely deficient or contradictory justification caps the whole reviewed row at70; safety findings remain explicit, not a reconstructed official safety aggregation.

output_protocol.august_routing_saved_answers: Unknown unless original messages, user state, candidate evidence/media and independent reference decisions are available. Metadata, schema, author errata or local dev accuracy do not establish final-output quality.

study_roles.development: Public May source re-review after rubric-drift diagnosis.
study_roles.external_exploratory: Different-edition public source/transcript with disclosed missing caches/data and participant-claimed submission correspondence.
study_roles.context_only: Cleaned-up public source with substituted demo data is not a matched score calibration case.

leakage_and_selection: Official targets and entrant identities were already known to this project before this protocol was frozen. This is NOT a truly blind holdout.
Fresh review bundles omit official scores/rank; reviewers must not target known results. This reduces direct prompting leakage, not prior knowledge or selection bias.
Two selected entrants across editions and unverified server-upload byte identity are insufficient for statistical calibration, ranking validation or general error guarantees.
comparison_policy: Preserve original v1 judgments and compute before/after only for the same available category/evidence.
Report signed/absolute observed gaps in weighted category points; do not call them matched prediction errors without verified submitted-artifact identity.
Do not invent a pre-revision score for a new external case, unknown categories, or rank accuracy from unlike tasks.
Do not choose revisions after seeing external results to force matching. Any future change requires a new protocol version and additional untouched evaluation evidence.
